sources.entry: Krayin - CRM solution for SMEs and Enterprises for complete customer lifecycle management. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Krayin CRM is an open-source customer relationship management framework built on Laravel and Vue.js, aimed at SMEs and enterprises for managing the full customer lifecycle.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a self-hostable CRM application built with Laravel (PHP) and Vue.js, described as free and open source for complete customer lifecycle management. The README mentions a descriptive admin panel, an admin dashboard, custom attributes, and a modular architecture. It notes email parsing via SendGrid. Installation uses Composer to create the project, a .env file for APP_URL, mail and database settings, and a php artisan krayin-crm:install command. The README also lists optional paid or separate offerings: a managed cloud hosting service, a multi-tenant SaaS edition, a WhatsApp lead-generation extension, and a VoIP trunk-calling extension.
use_cases: manage customer leads and sales pipeline
self-host a CRM for a small business
customize CRM fields with custom attributes
run a multi-tenant CRM for several businesses
parse incoming email into CRM records
how_to_run: Set APP_URL and Mail/Database parameters in the .env file
notable: Built on Laravel and Vue.js with a modular approach
Optional managed cloud hosting, multi-tenant SaaS, WhatsApp and VoIP extensions
caveats: Requires PHP 8.3+, Composer 2.5+, and at least 3 GB RAM
Production use requires running composer install --no-dev and configuring mail and database manually
WhatsApp, VoIP, cloud hosting, and multi-tenant SaaS are separate offerings and not necessarily part of the core repository
